newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU cannot confirm or deny weekend lira meeting.
newsitem.headline: EU cannot confirm or deny weekend lira meeting.

text.p: A European Commission spokesman could not confirm or deny on Friday that the Italian government had requested a meeting of the EU's monetary committee on Monday.
"I am not in a position to confirm or deny that statement," the spokesman said.
In Frankfurt, a senior source told Reuters on the fringes of the European Banking Congress that the Italian government had requested a meeting of the committee for Saturday.
"The Italians have requested a meeting of the monetary committee for tomorrow," the source, who declined to be identified, said.

The monetary committee is empowered to decide on membership of Europe's Exchange Rate Mechanism. Italy's Treasury Minister, Carlo Azeglio Ciampi, said earlier today that he wanted to take the lira back into the ERM this month. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
